  <h1 class="title">aj-starter-gold</h1>
  <p class="dek">An Angular + NestJS starter demonstrating basic three-layer architecture for a demo project.</p>

  <h2 class="h2">Why</h2>
  <p>I wanted a working reference for the pattern I actually reach for &mdash; presentation, business logic, data &mdash; small enough to stand up for a demo or a teaching moment without re-explaining the architecture from a blank repo every time.</p>

  <h2 class="h2">How it works</h2>
  <p>Angular on the frontend, NestJS on the backend, with the three layers kept visibly separate rather than folded together for convenience.</p>

  <h2 class="h2">What I learned</h2>
  <p>A demo doesn't need much scaffolding to make the architecture legible; past a certain point, more scaffolding makes the demo about the scaffolding instead of the pattern.</p>

  <h2 class="h2">Code</h2>
  <p class="mono-link"><a href="https://github.com/alexanderwiebe/aj-starter-gold">github.com/alexanderwiebe/aj-starter-gold</a></p>
</div>
